hackathon_story.one_line: ForgeHive proves an EnergyPlus digital twin can be optimized by a safety-conscious autonomous strategy pipeline.
hackathon_story.proof_summary: Layer 1 runs a baseline building simulation, applies a conservative eco strategy, simulates the optimized model, and exports measurable energy and carbon savings.
hackathon_story.why_it_matters: This creates trustworthy measured feedback before adding autonomous reasoning, safety governance, and learning loops.
hackathon_story.next_step: Layer 2 will add building state, strategy schema, safety governor and autonomous control brain.
